latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-vitamins skill.

- Provides daily self-improvement briefs for AI agents, sourced from Agent Vitamins.
- Supports fetching preview (free) or full actionable briefs (requires subscription token).
- Guides agents through assessing, recommending, and (upon approval) executing improvements.
- Includes clear rules for recommendation, context integration, and owner approval workflow.
- Detailed setup and authentication instructions provided for easy onboarding.
